reviews.text: My first experience was trash! I made a reservation for 7/21 at 945 and arrived 10 mins early. I was told there was a 30-45 minute wait for a table despite making a reservation. My date and I saw that there were orange sectionals. We asked about those. The lady with the orange shorts and I believe green tye-dye shirt who I assume was the host informed us it was a $50 minimum for each person not including hookah. We said ok and she sat us in the in the corner area by the speakers. She did not say anything else. She walked off. She Did not inform us if we had to order from the bar and bring it to the section. She didn't inform us if a server would be with us or anything. As this was my first time here I was genuinely confused. I saw a barcode paper in the table at the section next to us, but none at our table. Someone came out and placed silver bowls on all the tables with sectionals. However he never approached us or placed a silver bowl on the table in our section. For over forty five minutes we sat there in confusion. The dj was pretty good so the music helped pass the time. However we tried to get the attention of another worker in a black shirt bringing out orange cushions and pillows. And was ignored again. We got up and left. Of course no one said anything  as we walked past the host stand. I'm just shocked and baffled that this is the type of service being rendered. We are an African American  couple, and after reading the previous reviews I can't help but wonder if this played a part in the horrible service we received. Don't even waste your time coming here! Go somewhere else where both your business and money is respected, welcomed, and appreciated.

Also you're more welcome to come back and try our Happy hour we have Tuesday-Friday. reviews.name: Lauren Wilson
reviews.text:
My best friend had her birthday dinner here  and i hope she enjoyed it more than I did. It was extremely underwhelming. We were sat at this cute table right by the entrance to the right and it was off balanced. Every time we touched the table it moved so we asked 3 times if they could fix it. They said there was nothing they could do. Finally, they moved us to a new table which should have happened from the very beginning.

They sat us at another table in the area near the DJ and the music was extremely loud but it was a vibe. DJ was on point.

It took our waiter 25 minutes to come to our table. I advised that when he does come, put our entire order in because there is no telling when he will come back.

Drinks, decent.

Food…. Absolutely not.
I am a foodie and a MAJOR fan of asian cuisine. The food was not it. The portion sizes were very small for them to charge what they charge. It lacked flavor and presentation.

$50 for a hookah? Seriously?

But the best part for me was water (im hoping it was water) leaked from the ceiling falling on my face and clothes. I didn’t realize how much water fell on me until i touched my bun and it was damp. One drop fell in my eye and splatted all over my glasses. It’s unacceptable.

Parking sucks.

Pros: the art work was dope.

I will not be returning. I could have gotten the same meal for less than $25 in the hood with more flavor and bigger size portions.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hi Lauren, I'm really sorry to hear about your less than enjoyable experience at our restaurant. It’s disheartening that several aspects of your visit didn't meet your expectations, from the seating issues and wait time to the food and unfortunate water leak incident. Your feedback is invaluable, and we'll be reviewing all these points carefully to improve the experience for our guests.

reviews.name: Brittany Holland
reviews.text: I heard about Panda Harlem decided this would be the perfect location to celebrate one of my girlfriend’s birthdays.  I visited the restaurant in August 2023.  I made a reservation online, double check to ensure they accept walk ins.  When we arrived there was a representative that greeted us at the door and showed us in.  We then went to then confirmed our reservation and was seated.  This place is beautiful with the art on the walls it’s the perfect photo op. There is an upstairs and downstairs levels and two bars   Our server for the evening was very friendly and even provided recommendations for us.  There is also a staff member who walks around taking pictures.  You scan the QR code on the table for the menu.   It didn’t take long to receive our drinks or our food.  I had the Blue Hawaiian which I may say was very strong.  For our meals we had the Shanghai Ribs with the shrimp fried rice and the chicken and broccoli with white rice.  My girlfriend enjoyed every bite of her meal.   I thought the chicken and broccoli was okay.  For dessert we ordered the Tres Leche Cake in which the wrote Happy Birthday with a sparkler.  The restaurant has an overall great vide and the music was really good.  The only con I have is while we were eating and having a good time two different parties were seated near us and began doing hookah.  I don’t care if people do hookah however, I don’t want to smell nor experience it while I’m eating.  The restaurant wasn’t crowded at all so they could have put them in a different section.  I was completely upset with this and when we asked our waiter about it, he informed the other sections were closed.  This made us want to hurry up and leave the restaurant.  Although the restaurant accepts card there is an ATM located inside.  Like most places if you pay with card there is a service fee.   Gratuity was automatically added to the check.  This restaurant is near the water so you can get some great pics as well.   It’s also accessible via public transportation.   I may give them another try not so sure yet.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Hello Brittany, I really appreciate you sharing your experience with us. It's wonderful to know that your girlfriend enjoyed her birthday celebration and that you liked our art-decorated space, friendly service, and lively vibe. I'm sorry to hear about the inconvenience with the hookah nearby and seating limitations you faced. We're always here to listen and continuously improve, so we'll definitely take your feedback to heart.

reviews.text: One of the absolute worst dining experiences ever!  This place came highly recommended from a friend and what a severe disappointment it was!  This is not a family friendly restaurant if you have kids.  The experience began with obnoxiously loud music the minute you walked into the restaurant, it was so loud hostess could not hear me so I had to show her the reservation on my phone then we had to sit outside because everyone in the restaurant was smoking hookah or cigars which is against the law in NYC not that outside was any better but at least it was open air but all the hookah smoke would hit you and I have asthma and can't be around people smoking. They brought water right away, a short time later someone dropped a basket of bread on the table then about 15 mins later the waitress came to take order.  Almost not questions took the orders and walked away never saw he again until we were nearly finished eating then disappeared again.  Not once did anyone check or ask how the food was including the manager who walked by us twice but only went to tables where he knew people.  We waited 20 mins after we finished eating before I had to get up and walk over to the hotess to have he get the waitress, it had been 40 mins since the last time we saw her. Will never go back again or recommend this place!

reviews.name: Lizette Dawson
reviews.text: Horrible service! I came here for New Years Eve and never got our food. First time I take my children out for New Year’s to try something different but we left hungry and angry. It is a nice place good music with lots of energy but the service was horrible. Our reservations were for 9:15 we got there on time and were seated right away. There was someone going around serving champagne regularly and the hookah girl came around regularly as well. The restaurant was very crowded but at around 10:20 I started asking who’s going to take our order we were starving. The waitress came by took our order appetizer and main course. Our appetizer came out before 11pm we ate it quickly lol and thought the main course would come out in the next few minutes. We were a party of 9 so I thought it would take a little longer. The family (party of about 12) at the table next to us were there before us and they were also waiting for their food, they got their food around 1:15am. Everyone I asked about our food kept telling us 5min, 10 min, etc. By this time I was speaking to the manager who promised me the food was coming out in 10min, that never happened. At 1:30am we were heading out the door when they start bringing some of the food out. I told the manager just to pack it up for us we were hungry and exhausted by then. We waited another 15min in the car waiting for the take out now and he came out to apologize and basically said they ran out of food. My reservations were booked about 2wks ago $100 per person and it was a pre fixed dinner, I did get my deposit back. Check out the photo below at 11:11 we had a clean table waiting for our food. They ruined our New Years celebration. We left starving!
